title: Co-op sound: the listener moves toward the players (DPC 0.9.172)
intro: Two controllers (or keyboard + one controller), a full party, open ground, no enemies, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Sound on (headphones help). About 2 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
Starting classic co-op on your main pawn (you: the Arisen).
Walk the Arisen and the pawn apart (20-30 m) so the camera pulls back. DPC is finding how to move the listener: hold still-ish for a few seconds once apart. 25 seconds.

expect.label: listener move active with the camera pulled back
a way to move the listener was found

steps.text: Stay apart. LISTEN: footsteps, swings and voices of BOTH characters, also when one walks away from the camera. No sudden cut-off? 20 seconds.

expect.label: listener moved away from the camera (m)

steps.text: Same with the switch off (the game's listener at the camera): the cut-off should come back. 15 seconds.
Switch back on. Walk back together: the camera comes in and the listener goes back to the camera. 15 seconds.
Done. Tell Claude: did both characters stay audible apart? Did turning it off bring the cut-off back?
